I am writing to check on the status of my order #····. Could you please let

Thank you,
Zachary P.

Hi Zachary,

Thanks for writing in. I tried to pull up #···· and the order with that number isn't under your name, so I think the number may have a digit off or it's from a different reference.

Can you reply with the email address you used at checkout, or the postcode ····ships to? Either one is enough for me to find it, and I'll come straight back with where it is and the ship date.

Sorry for the extra step, and thanks for your patience.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
